method: Actual Batch, full Fortress._buildChunk, Level/Rng and merge/disposal on CPU material doubles, not GPU/FPS or integration acceptance

sweep.finiteLimits: Grid samples are not an exhaustive continuous collision proof. Rotation is analytic and unquantized over full source ranges. Nearest-sample point displacement bound <= maxPivotRadius*(.0015+.0025)=0.0173m; retain this conservative padding for unsampled poses, not a claim of exact mesh containment in original hexagonal barrel volumes.
sweep.continuousEmitterClearance: Rigid paired tip-frustum: lower-bound .312/sqrt(1+(.017/.41)^2)=.311732m from center emitter; all earlier jacket sections are >=.41m axially behind tip, bore lips >=.312m lateral. Yaw/pitch are rigid, so this bound is pose-invariant. Static/yaw-only hardware top2.35m stays >3.28m below the lowest center emitter. Source center spark rather than two muzzle sparks remains an explicit artistic compromise.

limitations: No production edits or loader integration. Recipe is an executable CPU-tested integration candidate.
Authored plinth sits at original roofY=0 contact; existing roof cap extends .22m above it, plus existing center HVAC intersects lower mount as in source. No roof surfaces or fixtures moved.
All-angle AABB containment sampled, not full topology intersection proof. Base3.3 vs source3.4; jacket eight-sided versus source six-sided produces intentionally different faceting.
No live GPU, real FPS, particle rendering, post-processing matching, or final acceptance.
No formal Opus review or fix rounds: pending_deferred_opus_review.

roofClearance.existingCenterHVAC: Source center roof fixture intersects lower mount, unchanged. No geometry or surface capture moved.
roofClearance.finiteLimit: All 114 measured roofs fit by >=.274m. Other seeds/theoretical minimum 3.8-wide roof at extreme .4 yaw may leave up to .131m base overhang, still less than original square3.4 footprint; not a universal roof-containment guarantee.

vertexMapping.runtime: Canonical typed positions and flat normals. Explicit per-part linear sRGB-decoded tint; source-like per-part height AO, face up-light/frontLift/sideLift; world dominant-face box UV /3. Normals rigidly rotated once at chunk build, no maps copied.
vertexMapping.GLB: COLOR_0 stores Batch linear tint/AO divided1.1 to avoid clipping source up-light1.1; node.extras.GLB_COLOR0_decode_gain restores it. Preview baseColorFactor includes1.1. Exported UV (u,1-v) decodes to source (u,v). Reference-pose GLB only; integration recomputes correct posed/world UV.
